What is this screen?
Got it
Your account and the market summarised on one screen: balance, a few symbols, open signals.
Everything here is a summary; each section\'s full figures are on its own screen.
Every symbol\'s live price and 24-hour change, in one list.
The percentage on a row is the change over the past 24 hours, not the change since midnight.
One symbol\'s price over time. Drag the ticker to change it; the pencil is the drawing tools, the sliders the indicators, and «…» holds depth of market, compare and the rest.
The last candle has not closed yet and keeps changing until the timeframe ends.
Published signals, each with its entry, stop loss and target.
A signal is a report, not advice; the size and the decision are yours.
You ask the model to analyse a symbol and read its answer here.
The model speaks from past data; what it produces is analysis, not a forecast.
Trading calculators: position size, risk, stop loss, profit and loss.
These only calculate; no order goes to an exchange from here.
Market news with its source named, newest first.
Stories are ordered by time, not by importance or by their effect on price.
When each economic figure is released, and the number the market expects.
Until the moment of release, the number you see is the forecast, not the actual figure.
You set conditions and the symbols that meet them are listed.
The list is a snapshot of this moment; symbols join and leave it on every refresh.
The whole market in one picture: each cell\'s colour is its price change and its size is that symbol\'s weight.
Cell size is not market cap; it is the liquidity or volume you chose in the settings.
The symbols you starred, kept apart from the full market list.
A watchlist is a list you watch, not a portfolio; starring a symbol buys nothing.
You set a price condition and get a notification when it is met.
An alert only tells you; it never opens or closes a trade.
You record each trade with why you entered and why you left, so the pattern in your mistakes becomes visible.
The journal is manual and reads nothing from a connected account; everything here you wrote yourself.
Practice trading on the real market with imaginary money.
The prices are real and the money is not; profit and loss here never reach a real account.
You run a trading rule over past data to see what it would have done.
The result is about that stretch of history only; a different stretch gives a different answer.
You write NamaScript indicators and strategies here and run them on the chart.
A script only calculates on the chart; it never places an order itself.
The record of your connected account\'s closed trades: net profit, win rate and worst drawdown.
Only closed trades are in these figures; an open position\'s floating profit is not counted.
You connect an exchange account with an API key so orders can be placed from the app.
The key is never stored on the phone, and withdrawal permission is not needed.
Your subscription\'s state, and which parts of the app each plan opens.
A subscription opens parts of the app, not profit or a guaranteed signal.
The record of your closed signals and executions.
Every figure here comes from your account; nothing is estimated on the phone.
Short lessons about the market and about using this app.
The lessons teach; none of them names a symbol to buy.
The buy and sell orders waiting in the exchange\'s book right now.
These orders have not been filled and can be pulled at any moment.
You find a symbol or a screen of the app by its name.
Persian names work too; you do not have to know the Latin ticker.

Animation
Short tip
Each tip appears once, at the moment you first reach that part of the app. Tap one to watch it again, or bring them all back.
Show all tips again
The tips will show again as you reach each place.
The drawing cursor
Drag anywhere to move the blue cursor, then tap to set the point exactly under it.
The floating toolbar
Drag the six dots to move the toolbar and tap them to fold it. Hold a tool to see the rest of its group.
Drag the six dots to move the toolbar and click them to fold it. Hold the button on a tool to see the rest of its group.
Pinch to zoom
Spread or pinch two fingers to zoom the chart. On the price column only the price scale zooms.
Scroll the wheel to zoom time; hold Ctrl and scroll to zoom price.
Stretch the price scale
Drag the price column up or down to stretch or squeeze the chart. Double-tap it to fit again.
Drag the price column up or down with the mouse. Double-click it to fit again.
Press and hold
Press and hold on the chart to keep the crosshair and read the price and time of any point.
Right-click the chart to open the menu for that price.
Back to the latest candle
Double-tap the chart to jump back to the latest candle.
Double-click the chart to jump back to the latest candle.
Switch symbols
Drag the symbol at the bottom up or down for the next one. Hold it to see its neighbours.
The chart bar
The pencil opens drawing mode, the sliders the indicators, the dots more tools, and the arrow takes back your last step.
Drawing mode bar
The magnet snaps points to candle prices; the lock and the eye lock or hide every drawing at once.
Move a drawing
Drag a drawing\'s points to reshape it, or drag its middle to move all of it.
The drawing\'s toolbar
Colour, width, lock, copy and delete for the selected drawing are all on this bar.
Alert from the price scale
Tap the + beside the price column to set an alert at that price.
Move the mouse beside the price column and click the + to set an alert at that price.
Move an alert
Drag the alert line up or down to change its price.
The A and L keys
A fits the price scale automatically; L makes it logarithmic.
Indicator names
Tap an indicator\'s name to read about it, hide it or change its settings.
Marks on the chart
The marks along the bottom of the chart are events and chart cues. Tap one for the details.
The marks along the bottom of the chart are events and chart cues. Click one for the details.
Jump to now
This button takes you back to the latest candle.
Replay
Step the candles forward one by one and see what the market did next. Exit returns you to the live chart.
Tidy your timeframes
Press and hold a timeframe to take it off this bar.
Hold the mouse button on a timeframe to take it off this bar.
Quick add to watchlist
Swipe a market\'s row sideways to add it to your watchlist.
Preview a market
Press and hold a row for a preview and more actions.
Hold the mouse button on a row for a preview and more actions.
Arrange your watchlist
Drag the handle beside a row to change the order of your watchlist.
The full version
Pro Chart on the web, at pro-chart.com, carries every feature. The menu has a link to it.
Manage drawings
Swipe a drawing aside to delete it. Hold and drag to change its order.
